items.title: Why Do Enterprise AI Pilots Struggle to Scale?
items.summary:
Many AI pilots look impressive—but turning them into reliable autonomous systems is a very different challenge.

In this short, the author of Architecting for Autonomy explains why enterprises struggle to move beyond experimentation, and what organizations need to consider before deploying agentic AI at scale—from architecture and governance to trust, oversight, and organizational readiness.

Learn more about Architecting for Autonomy, available through Manning’s Early Access Program: https://hubs.la/Q04tZ_p50
